pilot_note: Clarify knowing one another's character, not merely being familiar.
Make the ethical norms, rather than the civil servants themselves, the grammatical model for society.
Replace the calqued 'full of tourists' and specify successors who will continue fishing.
Use the precise Ukrainian term for a severely poor harvest: неврожай.
Do not imply construction had already begun; translate carrying it out despite bad weather.
Remove the unnecessary restriction to mass panic and retain the economic-crisis sense.
火気 is broader than an open flame; use a wider Ukrainian rendering.
Add the medical sense of another disease occurring in combination, distinct from 合併症.
業者 can denote a business operator/entity, not necessarily an individual entrepreneur.
Avoid adding unexpressed dimensions such as budget size and structure to 予算の在り方.
錯綜する can describe tangled information without requiring direct contradictions; make 対応に追われた natural.
Clarify later settlement/calculation of the monetary difference without assuming payment direction.
